text:
Type: pair of linen curtains
Use: dressing windows, filtering light and adding privacy; living room, bedroom, dining room
Style: Scandinavian, Japandi, coastal
Materials: semi-sheer washed linen with a slub texture, hidden tab top
Colors: natural beige, warm sand
Shape: two long straight panels that fall in soft vertical folds from a rod, gathered tab-top heading, fine uneven weave, light and airy
Feel: calm, warm, natural, airy
Goes with: light wood, white walls, rattan, cream or white textiles; Scandinavian, Japandi or coastal rooms

product.name: AINA
product.description: The curtains lower the general light level and provide privacy by preventing people outside from seeing directly into the room.
